risks.title: Exit depends on leasing the vacant suite
risks.message: The stated exit is 'Refinance to a major bank once the vacant suite is leased.' Repayment therefore depends on an event that has not yet happened. The application gives no detail on the size of the vacancy, any leasing campaign or agent, prospective tenants, or how long letting is expected to take within the 24-month term. Under §7.2 this higher-risk exit must be explained in the credit submission.

risks.title: No evidence the loan would meet bank refinance criteria
risks.message: The exit is refinance to a major bank, but the application gives no information on current rental income, occupancy or how the property would service a mainstream loan at the end of the term. With part of the building vacant, it is unclear whether a bank would refinance $4.95m on this security. Under §7.3 the credit submission should show that the loan would meet a mainstream lender's criteria at that point.
